memories.content: Staging Postgres runs on port 5432 behind the pgbouncer pool
The production Redis cluster has 3 shards with 2 replicas each
User passwords are hashed with Argon2id at 64 MiB memory cost
We chose SQLite over Postgres for the local cache because it needs zero setup
Deployments to production are frozen during the Friday demo window
Pointing the CDN at the origin IP instead of the load balancer caused an outage
The rate limiter counted retries as new requests and throttled legit users
Prefer terse answers with no filler text when replying
Always run the full test suite before pushing to main
Migrated the sessions table to the new schema on March 12 without downtime
Rotated the API signing keys after the audit finding on April 2
The billing service exposes Prometheus metrics on port 9102
The design mockups for the settings page live in Figma under Settings v3
The GraphQL gateway rate limit is 100 requests per minute per token
Adopted Feature Flag X for gradual rollout of the new checkout flow
Forgot to bump the migration revision, so the worker ran against a stale schema
Commit messages must reference the ticket number in the first line
Load test on May 3 peaked at 1200 requests per second with p95 latency of 180 ms
Onboarding docs live in the wiki under the Getting Started space
Nightly backups run at 02:00 UTC and are retained for 30 days
We use Rust for the ingest pipeline because it needs low GC pause times
Hardcoded the staging database password in a config file and had to rotate it
Code reviews should focus on correctness first and style second
Shipped version 2.4 of the mobile app to the beta channel on June 1
The office VPN requires the YubiKey token to be plugged in before connecting
The March outage was traced to a misconfigured pgbouncer pool that dropped idle connections
The Q1 decision was to freeze new infra purchases until the cost review closes
Quarterly security audit wrapped on February 20 with no critical findings
The billing service had a payment webhook backlog incident on April 15 that delayed invoices by a day
Q2 decision: migrate the analytics warehouse from Redshift to BigQuery
The July maintenance window on August 3 took the ingest pipeline offline for two hours
Deprecation notice: the v1 public API is scheduled for shutdown on December 31
Missing a migration revision bump made the worker read an outdated schema
When pushing to main, the complete test suite must pass first
Keeping the staging DB credential inside a checked-in config file forced an emergency rotation
Reviews should weigh correctness before any style nitpicks
Completed the SOC 2 evidence collection sprint on May 30
The internal artifact registry mirrors are hosted at mirror.internal.example.com
Postmortems go into the wiki under Incident Reports within one week of an incident
Agreed to standardize on OpenTelemetry for all new services starting next quarter
